theorems.name: Submission.cmcdtfrpi_isometry_image_integral
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (Φ : Euclid k → Euclid P) (A : Set (Euclid k)), Isometry Φ → MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet (Φ '' A) ∧ μHE[k] (Φ '' A) = volume A ∧ ∀ h : Euclid P → ℝ, ∫ x in Φ '' A, h x ∂μHE[k] = ∫ y in A, h (Φ y)
